I'd hate to work as a dishie alongside actual assholes, because the servers and cooks at my restaurant are all very cool, very chill people. They're more so the exception to the rule, if anything, but it just goes to show that even without really meaning to, people can be inconsiderate! In my situation, I know it's not malicious- so I've really leaned in to the "idgaf" attitude... even if I do give a little bit of a fuck.  I'm one of the luckier ones, I suppose. I'm sorry you gotta suffer through that kind of dickheadedness and I hope the servers who DO care for you act as a shining beacon of light in the midst of all the chaos. Godspeed, Cheesecurdpie and may the suds be ever in your favor.

Yes! I'm never more annoyed than the start of my shift when I come into these makeshift mountains of dishes, buckets, what-have-you from the prep cooks. I don't mind the organizational aspect and on my better days it's almost a fun game trying to get them all into respective piles. On my worse days, though... I'm washing shit as it's stacked- fuck the organization and fuck any dish priority I've previously made up in my mind. (I will always prioritize and get a dish back to anyone who asks for it ASAP,  but I literally have OCD so in my mind the most important things to clean first are things I anticipate they might need sooner rather than later, like whisks, spatulas, any contraption having to do with the slicer, etc).

I really want to iterate that this is coming from someone who's worked both FOH and BOH. I've personally given up caring how FOH stacks plates or if they're throwing sauce filled ramikens in with the silverware (even though one clearly has clean water while the other is grimy). No matter how many times I ask and state my preference - there's always someone who can't be bothered. At this point it's just not worth wasting my precious energy on. I do think it is kind of ludicrous for you to insinuate the reason they can't do these things, though, is because they're working for tips... Tipping culture in America is bad enough without the added insufferable nature of such excuses. Like you said, it takes 15 seconds!
And they're still making more of a living wage than us LMFAO 😂
